item.title: Police Shooting, DJ Fresh Funeral, Alive Fiber at 98
item.ns0:title: Police Shooting, DJ Fresh Funeral, Alive Fiber at 98
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, two police officers face an attempted murder investigation after a fifteen-year-old teenager is shot during a Friday night road check on Cowpen Road. Investigators probe a tragic apparent drowning off Goodman's Bay that claimed the life of a ninety-four-year-old visitor, while a runway oil spill at LPIA forces flight diversions and airport delays. We also bring you emotional moments from the final farewell to beloved disc jockey DJ Fresh International, alongside an urgent health advisory as a massive plume of Saharan dust approaches the islands. Plus, we highlight a ninety-eight-year-old Bahamian icon celebrating a local milestone and bring you your complete weekend sports and weather, so tune in to get fully caught up!
